name: The Thundering Elephant Parade
description: Majestic elephants with storm clouds swirling above their heads march across a landscape, their footsteps creating gentle rainbows in the mist.
prompt: Giant majestic elephants with swirling storm clouds above their backs march across a golden savanna landscape at sunset. Each gentle footstep creates mist that forms delicate rainbow arcs. Their trunks spray fine droplets that catch the last rays of sunlight. Lightning flickers softly in their dark gray skin like embedded gems. Acacia trees dot the horizon as the elephants move in peaceful procession. Warm orange and purple sky, epic scale, wildlife fantasy realism.
caption: When giants walk gently, the earth blooms with color and rainbows rise with every step... 🐘🌈
